title_en: Nanjing People's Procuratorate of Jiangsu Province v. Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei — fundraising fraud
ruling_gist_en: An actor who, for the purpose of illegal possession, fabricates the purpose of fundraising, uses false certification documents and high return rates as inducements, raises funds from the public without approval from the competent authority, and defrauds the raised funds, constitutes the crime of fundraising fraud as provided in Article 192 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China. In determining whether the actor has the purpose of illegal possession, the standard of unity of subjective and objective elements shall be adhered to, avoiding both purely objective imputation of guilt based on losses and reliance solely on the defendant's confession. The reasons for the actor's inability to repay the raised funds should be comprehensively analyzed based on the specific circumstances of the case. If the actor has not engaged in actual business operations or the proportion of actual business operations is extremely small, and it is fundamentally impossible to repay the principal and agreed interest from the prior illegal fundraising through normal operations, and the raised funds are concealed or squandered, the actor shall be deemed to have the purpose of illegal possession.

full_text_en:
**Jiangsu Province Nanjing Municipal People's Procuratorate v. Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, Ma Rumei — Fundraising Fraud Case**

**【Ruling Summary】**

Where an actor, with the purpose of illegal possession, raises funds illegally from the public without approval from competent authorities by fabricating the purpose of fundraising, using false certification documents and high rates of return as inducements, and defrauds fundraising proceeds, such conduct constitutes the crime of fundraising fraud as provided in Article 192 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China. In determining whether the actor has the subjective intent of illegal possession, the standard of unifying the subjective and objective aspects should be adhered to. It is necessary to avoid both objective imputation based solely on the loss result and reliance solely on the defendant's own confession. The reasons for the actor's inability to repay the raised funds should be comprehensively analyzed based on the specific circumstances of the case. If the actor has not engaged in substantive business operations, or the proportion of substantive business operations is extremely small, making it fundamentally impossible to repay the principal and agreed interest of the earlier illegally raised funds through normal business operations, and the raised funds are concealed or squandered, the actor shall be deemed to have the purpose of illegal possession.

**Prosecutorial Authority:** Jiangsu Province Nanjing Municipal People's Procuratorate.

**Defendants:**
- **Xu Guancheng** (also known as Xu Guancheng), male, 43 years old, Han ethnicity, formerly the legal representative of Beijing Guancheng Zhenxing Biotechnology Co., Ltd. and the legal representative and chairman of Nanjing Guancheng Zhenxing Biotechnology Co., Ltd., residing at Unit A, Taoran Ju, Caishikou South Street, Xuanwu District, Beijing. On September 1, 2005, he was placed under residential surveillance on suspicion of contract fraud. On January 20, 2006, he was criminally detained. On January 25, 2006, he was arrested on suspicion of illegally absorbing public deposits.
- **Xu Guanqing**, male, 52 years old, Han ethnicity, formerly the general manager of Nanjing Guancheng Zhenxing Biotechnology Co., Ltd., residing at Dongshandi Village, Hengshui Town, Jiang County, Shanxi Province. On September 1, 2005, he was placed under residential surveillance on suspicion of contract fraud. On January 20, 2006, he was criminally detained. On January 25, 2006, he was arrested on suspicion of illegally absorbing public deposits.
- **Ma Rumei**, female, 35 years old, Han ethnicity, college degree, formerly the financial director of Beijing Guancheng Zhenxing Biotechnology Co., Ltd., residing at Unit A, Taoran Ju, Caishikou South Street, Xuanwu District, Beijing. On September 1, 2005, she was criminally detained on suspicion of contract fraud. On September 30, 2005, she was placed under residential surveillance. On January 25, 2006, she was arrested on suspicion of illegally absorbing public deposits.

The Jiangsu Province Nanjing Municipal People's Procuratorate filed a public prosecution with the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court, Jiangsu Province, against Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei for the crime of fundraising fraud.

**Allegations in the Indictment:** On June 5, 2001, the defendant Xu Guancheng, together with an outsider Feng Xiaoyun (a nominal shareholder), established Beijing Molong Guancheng Science and Trade Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Beijing Molong Company"), and subsequently set up branches in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Chongqing, Nanjing, and other places. On November 17, 2003, Xu Guancheng, together with an outsider Ma Xiuping (a nominal shareholder), established Beijing Guancheng Zhenxing Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Beijing Guancheng Company"). On January 5, 2004, Xu Guancheng, together with the defendant Xu Guanqing, established Nanjing Guancheng Zhenxing Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Nanjing Guancheng Company"). After their establishment, the aforementioned companies primarily engaged in fundraising fraud activities. Xu Guancheng served as the legal representative of Beijing Guancheng Company and Nanjing Guancheng Company, responsible for overall work. Xu Guanqing served as the general manager of Nanjing Guancheng Company, representing Nanjing Guancheng Company in signing contracts with the victims in this case. The defendant Ma Rumei served as the financial director of Beijing Guancheng Company, specifically managing the fundraising proceeds collected by Xu Guancheng from various locations, including Nanjing Guancheng Company, and allocating payments and various expenses as directed by Xu Guancheng.

Starting from 2002, the defendant Xu Guancheng, without approval from relevant authorities in accordance with legal procedures, carried out illegal fundraising activities targeting unspecified members of the public under the name of the "Star Torch Plan" ("Xingju Jihua"). Between January 2004 and March 2005, Xu Guancheng, together with the defendants Xu Guanqing and Ma Rumei, acting in the name of Nanjing Guancheng Company, knowing that they were unable to repay the principal and interest, with the purpose of illegal possession, using high returns as bait, fabricated the purpose of fundraising, exaggerated the company's strength, used the later received investment funds to repay the principal and agreed interest of earlier investors, defrauding the trust of customers. Through these methods, they defrauded more than 800 unspecified members of the public of investment funds totaling over RMB 33.7 million. After obtaining the customer investment funds, Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei, in addition to paying the principal and agreed interest of earlier investors, also used the funds for personal living expenses (such as purchasing real estate and automobiles in their own names). Subsequently, they were unable to pay the principal and agreed interest to customers. After the case was uncovered, the public security authorities recovered from Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei the sum of RMB 1,686,656.02, HKD 1,257,630, USD 6,001, RUB 510, KRW 20,000, 393 pieces of calligraphy and painting, and a small amount of office supplies.

The defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei, with the purpose of illegal possession, illegally raised funds by fabricating the purpose of fundraising and using high rates of return as inducements, defrauding others of property in an especially huge amount. The conduct of all three defendants constitutes the crime of fundraising fraud as stipulated in the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter "Criminal Law"). It is a joint crime and criminal liability should be pursued according to law.

**Defense of Defendant Xu Guancheng:** The companies I operated were unable to repay the principal and agreed interest of some customers' earlier investments, causing losses to customers due to problems in the business model. However, I did not have the intent to defraud or illegally possess. Therefore, the charges brought by the prosecutorial authority are not established. Moreover, all matters in this case were planned and organized by me alone. The prosecutorial authority's determination that the defendants Xu Guanqing and Ma Rumei and I committed a joint crime lacks factual basis.

**Opinion of Defense Counsel for Xu Guancheng:**
1. The victims in this case entered into formal contracts with the companies involved, not with Xu Guancheng personally. Because of problems in the companies' production, operation, and management, as well as changes in market conditions, the companies' projects failed to generate the expected economic benefits, leading to the inability to return the raised funds. This is a civil dispute and does not constitute a crime. Even if it constitutes a crime, the subject of the crime should be the companies involved, not Xu Guancheng, and it should be a unit crime.
2. Xu Guancheng did not have the subjective intent to illegally possess the raised funds; his conduct does not constitute the crime of fundraising fraud.
3. Xu Guancheng has a good attitude in admitting guilt and requests a lenient punishment from the court.

**Defense of Defendant Xu Guanqing:** I did not have the intent to illegally possess the funds. Regarding whether we could repay the principal and agreed interest of all customers' earlier investments, I once reminded Xu Guancheng, who said he had a way. Therefore, the prosecutorial authority's claim that I knew we could not repay but still expanded operations lacks factual basis. Furthermore, Xu Guancheng's conduct and my conduct do not constitute a joint crime.

**Opinion of Defense Counsel for Xu Guanqing:**
1. Xu Guanqing did not have the intent to illegally possess the raised funds.
2. Xu Guanqing's role in the joint crime was relatively minor.
3. Xu Guanqing has a good attitude in admitting guilt and requests a lenient punishment from the court.

**Defense of Defendant Ma Rumei:** No defense opinion.

**Opinion of Defense Counsel for Ma Rumei:**
1. The evidence supporting the characterization of this case as fundraising fraud is insufficient.
2. Ma Rumei played a significantly secondary and auxiliary role in this case and should be clearly distinguished from the principal offenders. Requests the court to impose a mitigated punishment.

**Facts Found by the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court at First Instance:**

On June 5, 2001, the defendant Xu Guancheng, together with the outsider Feng Xiaoyun (a nominal shareholder), established Beijing Molong Company, and subsequently set up branches in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Chongqing, Nanjing, and other places. On November 17, 2003, Xu Guancheng, together with the outsider Ma Xiuping (a nominal shareholder), established Beijing Guancheng Company. On January 5, 2004, Xu Guancheng, together with the defendant Xu Guanqing, established Nanjing Guancheng Company. After their establishment, the aforementioned companies primarily engaged in fundraising fraud activities. Xu Guancheng served as the legal representative of Beijing Guancheng Company and Nanjing Guancheng Company, responsible for overall work. Xu Guanqing served as the general manager of Nanjing Guancheng Company, representing Nanjing Guancheng Company in signing contracts with the victims in this case. The defendant Ma Rumei served as the financial director of Beijing Guancheng Company, specifically managing the fundraising proceeds collected by Xu Guancheng from various locations, including Nanjing Guancheng Company, and allocating payments and various expenses as directed by Xu Guancheng.

Starting from 2002, the defendant Xu Guancheng, violating the relevant regulations of the People's Bank of China and without approval from relevant authorities in accordance with legal procedures, promoted the "Star Torch Plan" for illegal fundraising. He signed three series of contracts with customers: a special medicinal ant sales contract, a special medicinal ant entrusted breeding contract, and a special medicinal ant repurchase contract, promising customers that for each nest of ants invested at RMB 460, RMB 640 would be returned after one year, an annual return rate of 39.13%. After October 2004, the contracts were adjusted to an investment of RMB 460 per nest of ants, with a return of RMB 540 after one year, an annual return rate of 17.39%.

Between January 2004 and March 2005, the defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei, acting in the name of Nanjing Guancheng Company, knowing that they were unable to repay the principal and interest, using high returns as bait, fabricated the purpose of fundraising for illegal fundraising. They represented to unspecified members of the public that the raised funds would be used for the development, research, and production of ant products. In fact, although Xu Guancheng had some cooperation with relevant entities regarding the development, research, and production of ant products, the amount of funds invested accounted for a very small proportion of the funds raised. Beijing Guancheng Company had virtually no business activities. The main activities of Nanjing Guancheng Company were raising customer funds and repaying due principal and profits, while the amount of funds invested in the development, research, production, and sale of ant products and in ant breeding was very small. During the fundraising process, the defendants fabricated facts and exaggerated the company's strength. Promotional materials distributed to unspecified members of the public stated that the "Star Torch Plan" was being promoted nationwide by the China Old Revolutionary Area Poverty Alleviation Work Committee and the China Science and Technology Poverty Alleviation Work Committee of the State Council Leading Group Office of Poverty Alleviation and Development; and that the "China Guancheng International Science and Technology Group" was established in February 2003, with Nanjing Guancheng Company and Beijing Guancheng Company being its subordinate companies and subsidiaries. In fact, the State Council Leading Group Office of Poverty Alleviation and Development had never established or supervised the China Old Revolutionary Area Poverty Alleviation Work Committee or the China Science and Technology Poverty Alleviation Work Committee. Xu Guancheng confessed that after the establishment of the China Guancheng Group, it never conducted any business and had no relationship with the Nanjing and Beijing Guancheng companies. The purpose of raising funds under the name of the China Guancheng Group was to advertise the company's strong economic strength and large scale, enabling customers to trust that the company had the ability to repay their investments. The three defendants used the later received investment funds to repay earlier investments, defrauding customer trust. In total, they defrauded 829 unspecified members of the public of investment funds totaling RMB 33,278,700. The huge amounts of defrauded funds were all deposited into the personal accounts of the three defendants and were possessed and controlled by them. In addition to being used to pay customer investments and agreed interest, the funds were also used for personal living expenses and for purchasing real estate and automobiles in their own names. Subsequently, the three defendants were unable to pay customer investments and agreed interest.

After the case was uncovered, the public security authorities seized from the defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei property including RMB 1,686,656.02, HKD 1,257,630, USD 6,001, RUB 510, KRW 20,000, 393 pieces of calligraphy and painting, 2 computer hosts, 1 Toshiba laptop, 1 portable DVD player, 1 Canon camcorder, 1 Samsung mobile phone, 1 USB flash drive, 1 Panasonic mobile phone, and other items.

The above facts are confirmed by the following evidence, which has been subjected to cross-examination: testimony of witnesses Ma Xiuping, Men Licong, Liu Juan, Liu Jinlong, Zhao Jun, Dai Youpeng, Guo Zhigui, Li Xiaofeng, Zhou Wenmei, Yang Min, Chen Xiuman, Yuan Youxian, Zhang Yuxiang, Qin Shengxiang, Gao Jing, Ni Yi, Li Hongshui, Liao Zhihang; statements of victims Puyang Daidi, Chen Zhengfu, Chen Jing, Fan Jie, Zhao Mingke, Ye Shujun, Chen Kaiwei, and other victims; documentary evidence such as contracts and receipts provided by the victims; confessions of the defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei; business registration materials of Beijing Molong Company, Nanjing Molong Company, Beijing Guancheng Company, and Nanjing Guancheng Company; revenue and expenditure statements of Nanjing Guancheng Company; promotional materials for the opening of Nanjing Aixin Chain Stores; a situation explanation from the 452nd Hospital of the People's Liberation Army; certificates from the Sichuan Academy of Traditional Chinese Medicine; inspection reports from the Sichuan Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention; promotional materials titled "Guancheng Symphony" chronicling major events; promotional materials titled "Guan"; materials from the State Council Leading Group Office of Poverty Alleviation and Development; materials on seized property, search records, household registration information of Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei, and records of their arrests, all of which are on file and sufficient to prove the facts.

The disputed issues at first instance in this case were:
1. Whether this case constitutes a unit crime;
2. Whether the defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei used fraudulent methods to raise funds illegally;
3. Whether the three defendants had the subjective intent to illegally possess the raised funds;
4. Whether this case constitutes a joint crime.

**Opinion of the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court:**

The prosecutorial authority charged the defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei with the crime of fundraising fraud. Article 192 of the Criminal Law provides: "Whoever, for the purpose of illegal possession, uses fraudulent methods to raise funds illegally, if the amount is relatively large, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined not less than RMB 20,000 but not more than RMB 200,000; if the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined not less than RMB 50,000 but not more than RMB 500,000; if the amount is especially huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined not less than RMB 50,000 but not more than RMB 500,000 or have property confiscated." Article 199 provides: "Whoever commits the crimes provided for in Articles 192, 194, and 195 of this Section, if the amount involved is especially huge and causes especially heavy losses to the interests of the State and the people, shall be sentenced to life imprisonment or the death penalty, and shall also have property confiscated." According to the above provisions, to determine whether the crime of fundraising fraud is constituted, it is necessary to analyze whether the actor subjectively has the intent to illegally possess the raised funds; and objectively, whether the actor used fraudulent methods to raise funds illegally, and whether the amount raised has reached the statutory standard. The sentencing range for the crime of fundraising fraud is determined by the amount of illegally raised funds and the extent of social harm caused by the fundraising fraud. In this case, the defendants defrauded a total of RMB 33,278,700 in fundraising proceeds, and the public security authorities only recovered a small portion. This fact satisfies the provision of Article 199 regarding "especially huge amount and causing especially heavy losses to the interests of the State and the people." Therefore, the key issues in this case are the identification of the subject of the crime, whether the actors used fraudulent methods to raise funds illegally, and whether the actors had the intent to illegally possess the raised funds.

**I. Regarding the First Disputed Issue:**

The defense counsel for defendant Xu Guancheng argued that this case should be a unit crime. The court holds that although the victims in this case indeed signed contracts with the companies involved rather than with the defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei personally, and the acts in question were nominally carried out in the name of the units, in reality, the proceeds from the fundraising fraud did not belong to the units. The fundraising proceeds were all deposited into the personal accounts of Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei and were possessed and controlled by the three defendants. Article 2 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Cases of Unit Crimes provides: "If a company, enterprise, or institution established for the purpose of engaging in illegal or criminal activities commits a crime, or if, after the establishment of a company, enterprise, or institution, its main activity is committing crimes, it shall not be treated as a unit crime." In this case, Xu Guancheng established Beijing Guancheng Company and Nanjing Guancheng Company for the purpose of engaging in illegal fundraising activities, and after their establishment, the aforementioned companies' main activity was committing fundraising fraud. This case is essentially a natural person crime carried out using the corporate shell and should not be deemed a unit crime.

**II. Regarding the Second Disputed Issue:**

Article 1 of the Notice of the People's Bank of China on Issues Concerning the Cessation of Illegal Financial Institutions and Illegal Financial Business Activities provides: "Illegal fundraising refers to the act of a unit or individual, without approval from relevant authorities in accordance with legal procedures, raising funds from the public by issuing stocks, bonds, lottery tickets, investment fund securities, or other debt certificates, and promising to repay the principal and pay interest or give returns to the investors in currency, in kind, or other means within a certain period." It has the following characteristics: (1) Without approval from relevant authorities according to law; (2) Promising to repay the principal and pay interest to investors within a certain period; (3) Raising funds from unspecified targets, i.e., the public; (4) Covering the illegal nature of fundraising with a legitimate form. Based on the facts found in this case, the defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei, without approval from relevant authorities, signed three series of contracts with customers: a special medicinal ant sales contract, a special medicinal ant entrusted breeding contract, and a special medicinal ant repurchase contract. They promised customers that for each nest of ants invested at RMB 460, RMB 640 would be returned after one year, an annual return rate of 39.13%. After October 2004, the contracts were adjusted to an investment of RMB 460 per nest of ants, with a return of RMB 540 after one year, an annual return rate of 17.39%. These contracts promised to repay the principal and pay interest to investors within a certain period, raising funds from unspecified members of the public. This act of raising funds constitutes illegal fundraising. During the illegal fundraising process, Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei, knowing that they were unable to repay the principal and interest, using high returns as bait, fabricated the purpose of fundraising, falsely claimed that the raised funds were used for ant breeding, development, research, and sale of ant products. During the fundraising process, they falsely represented that the "Star Torch Plan" they implemented was being promoted nationwide by the China Old Revolutionary Area Poverty Alleviation Work Committee and the China Science and Technology Poverty Alleviation Work Committee of the State Council Leading Group Office of Poverty Alleviation and Development; and falsely represented that Nanjing Guancheng Company and Beijing Guancheng Company were subordinate companies and subsidiaries of the China Guancheng International Science and Technology Group established in February 2003, which was financially strong. Their conduct constituted deceiving unspecified members of the public into investing by fabricating and exaggerating the company's strength. In summary, it can be determined that the three defendants used fraudulent methods to raise funds illegally.

**III. Regarding the Third Disputed Issue:**

Regarding the determination of "intent to illegally possess" in the crime of fundraising fraud, the standard of integrating subjective and objective elements should be adhered to. It is necessary to avoid both simply imputing criminal liability based on the loss result alone and relying solely on the defendant's own confession. Instead, the analysis should be combined with the specific circumstances of the case. In this case, after the defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei fraudulently obtained huge sums of raised funds, all funds were deposited into their personal accounts and were possessed and controlled by the three defendants. The funds were not used for the purposes stipulated in the contracts. Only a very small amount of funds was invested in ant breeding and the development, research, and sale of ant products. Part of the later-received investment funds was used to honor the principal and the agreed high interest of the earlier investments. The remaining portion, in addition to being used for the operating expenses of the涉案 companies, was used by Xu Guancheng and Ma Rumei to purchase real estate and automobiles in their personal names. Xu Guancheng claimed that the涉案 companies were unable to honor the principal and agreed interest for some clients' earlier investments, causing losses to the clients, because of problems with the business model. In fact, the proportion of实体 operations by the three defendants was extremely small, and they were completely unable to repay the illegally raised principal and agreed interest through normal business operations. They even squandered the raised funds. Therefore, it should be determined that they subjectively had the intent to illegally possess.

IV. Regarding the Fourth Disputed Issue:

Defendant Xu Guancheng was the legal representative of Beijing Guancheng Company and Nanjing Guancheng Company, responsible for overall work. Defendant Xu Guanqing was the general manager of Nanjing Guancheng Company and actively participated in the illegal fundraising. Defendant Ma Rumei was the financial director of Beijing Guancheng Company and, under the instructions of Xu Guancheng, specifically managed the funds obtained by Xu Guancheng through fundraising fraud. Xu Guancheng, as the legal representative of Beijing Guancheng Company and Nanjing Guancheng Company, Xu Guanqing, as the general manager of Nanjing Guancheng Company, and Ma Rumei, as the financial director of Beijing Guancheng Company, were all aware of the basic situation regarding the collection of fundraising funds by Nanjing Guancheng Company and the use and flow of those funds. The three defendants should have known that the development and research of related ant products were not yet mature, and that the output and products were far from sufficient to honor the high interest. Under these circumstances, the three defendants still promoted the "Star Torch Plan" in Nanjing, each performing their own duties and cooperating with division of labor, jointly causing the situation where Nanjing Guancheng Company was unable to honor the huge amount of illegally raised funds. This should be determined as a joint crime. Xu Guancheng planned and directed the fundraising fraud activities. Xu Guanqing signed contracts with the victims and collected investment funds, actively participating in the fundraising fraud activities. Both were principal offenders. Ma Rumei, under the direction of Xu Guancheng, carried out acts such as collecting raised funds and allocating redemption payments, playing a secondary role in the joint crime. She should be determined as an accessory and may be given a mitigated punishment.

The defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei, with the intent to illegally possess, illegally raised funds by fabricating facts and using high rates of return as bait, defrauding others of property. The amount was extremely huge and caused particularly great losses to the people's interests, constituting the crime of fundraising fraud and being a joint crime. The facts charged by the People's Procuratorate of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, against Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei for the crime of fundraising fraud are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, and the charges are established. In summary, the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment on June 12, 2008:

1. Defendant Xu Guancheng is convicted of fundraising fraud and sentenced to death, with a two-year suspension of execution, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property. Defendant Xu Guanqing is convicted of fundraising fraud and sentenced to life imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property. Defendant Ma Rumei is convicted of fundraising fraud and sentenced to fifteen years' imprisonment, and a fine of RMB 500,000. 2. The criminal proceeds of the three defendants seized in the case, amounting to RMB 1,686,656.02, HKD 1,257,630, USD 6,001, RUB 510, KRW 20,000, as well as 393 pieces of calligraphy and painting, 2 computer hosts, 1 Toshiba laptop, 1 portable DVD, 1 Canon camcorder, 1 Samsung mobile phone, 1 USB drive, 1 Panasonic mobile phone, and other property, shall be recovered and returned to the victims. Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei are ordered to continue to make restitution of their criminal proceeds to the victims.

After the first-instance judgment was announced, within the statutory period, the prosecutorial authority did not lodge a protest, and the defendants Xu Guancheng, Xu Guanqing, and Ma Rumei did not file an appeal. The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court, in accordance with the law, reported the judgment against Xu Guancheng to the Jiangsu High People's Court for approval.

The Jiangsu High People's Court, upon review, confirmed the facts found in the first instance.

The Jiangsu High People's Court held upon review:

Defendant Xu Guancheng, in collusion with others, with the intent to illegally possess, illegally raised funds by fabricating facts and using high rates of return as bait, defrauding others of property. The amount was extremely huge and caused particularly great losses to the people's interests. His actions constituted the crime of fundraising fraud. Xu Guancheng, as the legal representative of Beijing Guancheng Company and Nanjing Guancheng Company, was responsible for overall work, planned and directed the fundraising fraud activities, and was a principal offender in the joint crime. The first-instance judgment convicting Xu Guancheng of fundraising fraud and sentencing him to death, with a two-year suspension of execution, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property is accurate, and it is hereby approved.
